# APSW Labs - AI-Native Architecture & Turnkey Engineering Studio

> Models guess. Engines verify. APSW Labs combines Principal-led system architecture and deterministic AI pipelines with elastic partner engineering capacity. Led by Piotr Solarz-Wnęk, Principal Software Architect, creator of Indaba and Gridwright.

Website: https://apsw.pl (also https://apswlabs.com)
Contact: piotr.solarz-wnek@apsw.pl | +48 666 522 923
GitHub: https://github.com/yaotzin1
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/piotrsolarzwnek/

## Delivery model: Principal-led, elastic capacity
1. Principal Wedge & Blueprint (APSW Labs core): the Principal Architect personally defines C4 boundaries, domain contracts, security isolation and the repository CI guardrails in workflow.ai.yml. No sales reps in between.
2. Autonomous Core Synthesis (APSW Labs engine): core modules, data pipelines and MVPs are synthesized and verified with @indaba/engine and multi-agent councils.
3. Elastic Partner Scale-Out (software house squads): when a system needs 4-8 engineers for long-term expansion, mobile apps or a 24/7 SLA, vetted partner squads work inside the pre-configured workflow.ai.yml repository, governed by automated CI gates.

## Engagement tracks
High-velocity lab sprints:
- Track 01, 10-Day Architecture & AI Readiness Blueprint (entry wedge, fixed scope): codebase and microservice audit, C4 target blueprints, security and isolation review, executable workflow.ai.yml roadmap.
- Track 02, Turnkey Core MVP / Module Sprint (APSW Labs delivery, 3-6 weeks): a complete MVP, high-load telemetry backend or 10M-row Gridwright Pro interface, with over 90% automated contract tests and Docker / Cloud IaC.
- Track 03, Deterministic AI Factory Setup (in-house team enablement, 2-3 weeks): the engineering standard behind Gridwright installed into your repository: workflow.ai.yml tracks, multi-agent review councils, CI drift guards, senior engineering playbooks.

Scaled partner delivery:
- Track 04, Full-Scale Platform & Dedicated Squads (architect-led plus software house): enterprise product development, legacy modernization or dedicated squads in Java 21, Symfony 8, React and Cloud / Data. Architected and gated by APSW Labs, scaled and staffed by a software house.

## Open source (MIT)

### Indaba (@indaba/engine)
- Tagline: "Let your agents argue. Ship what they agree on."
- Version 0.1.0-alpha.5 (npm dist-tag `next`), preview; the API is not stable below 1.0. TypeScript, Node 22+. Try: `npx indaba@next validate workflow.ai.yml`
- A declared graph of steps behind exit-code guards; multi-agent council consensus with a human arbiter fallback; runs Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, Cursor or Antigravity in disposable git worktrees; OpenTelemetry GenAI traces where tokens and cost come from the provider or are marked unknown, never invented.
- Documentation: https://yaotzin1.github.io/indaba/
- Source: https://github.com/yaotzin1/indaba

### Gridwright (apsw-gridwright)
- Tagline: "The React data grid that does not care where your rows live."
- Version 0.24.0. React 18 and 19, optional MUI package (apsw-gridwright-mui). Install: `npm install apsw-gridwright apsw-gridwright-mui`
- Built by one architect using the Indaba engine and covered by 1,300+ automated tests. Zero runtime dependencies, about 22 kB gzipped, up to ten million rows with row and column virtualization, real HTML table semantics with a WCAG 2.2 AA add-on. When a server sends no count, the grid says "of many" instead of inventing a number.
- Documentation: https://yaotzin1.github.io/apsw-gridwright/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/apsw-gridwright
- Source: https://github.com/yaotzin1/apsw-gridwright

## Reference build: Idumela
- Idumela is APSW's own B2B reputation engine: it monitors a brand's reviews, drafts replies in the brand's voice, and publishes only after a manager approves.
- Multi-tenant, Symfony 8 + React / MUI, tenant isolation and a token-credit ledger. Built in 2 weeks, agent-written from specifications behind pre-commit quality gates. Internal APSW Labs product, not yet public.

## The engineering standard
One workflow.ai.yml outranks every prompt. AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and GEMINI.md are generated from it, pre-commit hooks and CI enforce it, and CI fails when a repository instruction drifts from it: https://apsw.pl/#assurance
